d:
Nitish setu ke udghatan samaroh men mukhyamantri nitish kumar ki gairmaujudgi ko lekar saval uthe. is par mantri vijay kumar sinha ne saphaee dete hue kaha ki nitish kumar ne khud karyakram men jane ko uchit nahin bataya tha. vijay kumar sinha ke mutabik, pul ka nam nitish kumar ke nam par tha aur unhonne is sanbandh men unse mulakat bhi ki thi.
Iske alava vijay kumar sinha ne tejasvi yadav ke bayan par palatvar kiya aur raghopur men NDA sarkar ke vikas karyon ka jikr kiya. unhonne pradhanmantri narendr modi ke bihar daure aur krishi, rojgar va vikas se jure muddon par bhi apni bat rakhi.
